4. Surcharges
Seller reserves the right to apply a tariff surcharge to invoices for products subject to additional import duties, in
an amount not to exceed the duties actually paid. The surcharge will be shown as a separate line on the
invoice.
clauses.reasoning: Tariffs were passed through as a surcharge but the clause is silent on refunds.
